Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class Sphere extends Shape implements Spatial {
    private double radius;

    public double getRadius() {
        return radius;
    }

    public void setRadius(double radius) {
        this.radius = radius;
    }

    @Override
    public double area() {
        return 4.0 * Math.PI * Math.pow(radius, 2);
    }

    @Override
    public double volume() {
        return (4.0 * Math.PI * radius * radius * radius) / 3;
    }
}
